sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000077-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Atlantic Health Network 077 on July 17, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 500 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
